note: Each mob's art rules (world/mobs.ts, and the bot's web/town-mobs.ts; its art is manifest mobs.<id>; how mobs live, aggro, reach, attack pace, leash, respawn: classes/stats.json mobBehaviour). Frames are 0-based (the art READMEs count some from 1; these win). attackFrame = the attack anim's frame where the hit lands; charge = the Tire Roller's lunge frames (first, last); shadow = [w, h] art px of the ground shadow, centred on the anchor; floats = the sprite hangs above its anchor (the shadow stays on the ground there); variants = the looks, one picked per spawn (keep in step with manifest mobs.<id>.variants). pack = a pack's size (lowest, highest: a seeded count, each its own mob round a leader); roll = the Tire Roller's idle roll now and then (chance after a rest, tiles straight along its facing, tiles a second); drift = it drifts (its pace in tiles a second, its rests in ms: short, so it keeps floating); slowMs = its attack slows the player hit (shown only); shell = hits from a player in its front quarter are blocked; eye = where its zap leaves (art px in the SE cell; mirrored for SW and NW). The golem: attackFrame = Tire Slam, tossFrame = Scrap Toss's release, glareFrames = the Lamp Glare cone's first and last frame; radius = its body's radius in tiles (reach to it is measured to that edge); top = the art's highest pixel row in its cells (its HP bar, name and numbers go there, not at the cell's top); lamp = its lamp per facing (art px in that facing's cell: enrage, glare and the lamp burst start there); slamFist = the ground under its fist as the Tire Slam lands (the impact); tossFist = its raised fist on the Scrap Toss's release (the scrap leaves there). Measured from the art.

barong-barong.note: frame = the art's box over every sheet (cell px: left, top, right, bottom), what the boss camera keeps in view in its hall; Repo addition (Scrap Warrens, 10 Oct 2026): Barong-Barong, the Shanty Titan. S only and never moves (its moves are the run's: bot web/town-warrens.ts, timed from manifest hitFrames); attackFrame = its slams' hit frame; radius = dungeons.json lastBoss.reachRadius; top = its art's top (its name over it); shadow = a wide one under its heap.

biikko-kalabasa.note: Repo addition (Halloween 2026): an event mob that never attacks (no attackFrame); its candle glow is the manifest's glow sheet over it.

manananggal-upper.note: Repo addition (Halloween 2026): the Manananggal's upper half, an event mob that flies (bot web/halloween.ts moves it); Claw Swipe lands on frame 3. Drawn at 0.65 (its art is 46 px tall, a character about 37: Mac found it too big), dazed behind its carrier too; its shadow scales with it.

payong-flapper.note: Repo addition (Lumang Palengke, 20 Oct 2026; `sounds` false: the palengke mobs have no hurt or death sounds yet, so none are asked for): opening its umbrella (attack frames 0-2) it takes `block.share` of the damage from its front quarter, then pokes on frame 4.

sibuyas-sobber.note: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): a hit leaves a tear cloud on the player: -`tear.accuracy` points of accuracy (their attacks miss that much more often) for `tear.ms`; a new one restarts it.

garapon-jars.note: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): packs of 3 (the pack assists: stats.json mobBehaviour packAssist); its zone keeps `alive` packs about.

sako-slammer.note: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): its belly slam leaves spilled rice on the player's tile as it lands, for `rice.ms`: anyone standing on it walks at `rice.slow` of their speed.

monobloc-stack.note: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): ranged (stats.json mobBehaviour rangeTiles). Its chair leaves on its attack frame toward the tile the player stood on, `chair.speed` px a second, and hits only if they're still within `hitTiles` there as it lands. At each `loseAt` share of its HP it loses a chair: -`atkPerChair` of its ATK each, back when it heals.

sangkalan-chomper.note: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): it always takes `block.share` of the damage from its front quarter (the 90 degrees it faces); its sides and back take it all.

banyera-lurker.note: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): only on its zone's spawn points on `ambush.ground`, at most `alive`. It lies hidden there (not drawn, not targetable: a ripple) until a player comes within `ambush.tiles`; it rises (`riseMs`) and its first hit from hiding does x`firstHit`. `hideMs` after losing its target it's home and hidden again.

timbangan-sentinel.note: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): Weigh: its hit is x(1 + `perHp` x the player's share of their HP left): x1.5 on a full-HP player, x1.0 at 0; shown orange (and its dial flashes) from x`flashAt`.

great-scale.note: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): the Great Scale, the Palengke field boss. attackFrame: Pan Slam lands; weighFrame: the Weigh-in grab; coneFrame: Kulang sa Timbang; callFrame: its Sentinels drop in. Its shadow 2.5x a mob's, its body's radius in tiles (reach is to its edge), `pace` the tiles a second it walks (slow, heavy hops).

monobloc-stack-frost.note: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): the Silong's frost monobloc-stack (the art folder's silong/mobs/monobloc-stack-frost): its original's traits.

sangkalan-chomper-frost.note: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): the Silong's frost sangkalan-chomper (the art folder's silong/mobs/sangkalan-chomper-frost): its original's traits.

banyera-lurker-frost.note: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): the Silong's frost banyera-lurker (the art folder's silong/mobs/banyera-lurker-frost): its original's traits.

frost-scale.note: Repo addition (20 Oct 2026): the Silong's frost timbangan-sentinel (the art folder's silong/mobs/frost-scale): its original's traits; drawn at 0.75 (silong.json: small).

makinang-yelo.note: Repo addition (21 Oct 2026): Ang Makinang Yelo, the Ice Machine (Ang Silong's last boss). SW only and never moves (its moves are the run's: bot web/town-silong-bosses.ts, timed from the manifest's hitFrames); radius = dungeons.json silong.lastBoss.reachRadius; top = its art's top (its name over it); noShadow: it stands on its own floor slab; frame = its art's box over every sheet.
